tools.name: issues
tools.description: Lists the project's issues, sub-issues included, a line each: id, status, priority, assignee, title.

status.description: A status id (todo, in-progress, in-review, done…) or kind (started…)

q.description: In the id, title, notes or comments

open.description: Leave out done and canceled (default true); false lists every status

tools.name: issue
tools.description: An issue with its open sub-issues, PRs, branches, latest comments and open questions in full.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Adds an issue; proposal: true puts it to the owner instead of making it work.

status.description: A status id (todo, in-progress, in-review, done…) or kind (started…)

priority.description: P0 is urgent; null clears it

external.description: Team tracker task ids or URLs

github_issues.description: GitHub issues it came from: 523, owner/name#523

parent.description: Makes it a sub-issue of this issue

release.description: The release version it ships in

depends_on.description: Issues it waits on (all); chain ordered follow-ups

choices.description: A proposal's questions for the owner: {key, question, options: [{key, title, body?}], pick?: one|any, recommended?: [option keys], from?: {choice, option} (follows on from one)}

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Changes an issue's fields, as create_issue takes them; proposal "pending" puts it (back) to the owner.

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Comments on an issue (Markdown); asks waits at the top of the owner’s bell until they answer.

tools.name: releases
tools.description: Lists the project's releases with their branches and progress; of the shipped ones, only the latest unless all.

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Lists the project's docs (decisions, how things work), a line each. Read the ones a task touches before its code.

tools.name: doc
tools.description: A doc in full: the latest, unless revision (history lists them, a deleted doc's too).

tools.name: write_doc
tools.description: Writes a doc, new or replacing the one with this id: a decision and why, or how something works.

section.description: e.g. Decisions; kept when left out, empty for none

tools.name: guide
tools.description: How orrery itself works (issues, proposals, schedules, sessions, the launcher, its pages…), for questions about it rather than the project.

tools.name: more_tools
tools.description: Adds tools: schedules (ask the owner on your issue for one), secrets (the keys egress can use, by name), debug (orrery's event log), review (rate each PR you open), epics (work across projects).

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Answers the owner in the chat, in Markdown: the only way what you say reaches them. Say an issue you made by its id.

tools.name: edit_issue
tools.description: Changes an issue's title, notes, priority, labels, team tasks, GitHub issues, milestone, epic, release, parent or what it depends on, when the owner asks in this chat. To move one to another status or assign it, use move_issues.

priority.description: P0 is urgent; null clears it

release.description: The release version it ships in

parent.description: Makes it a sub-issue of this issue

depends_on.description: Issues it waits on (all); chain ordered follow-ups

tools.name: move_issues
tools.description: Moves issues in this project to a status (an id or a kind: todo, done…), or assigns them (a name, owner, or null). At once if the owner named each in their last message or is on its page; else asks them. Not a proposal waiting on the owner.

tools.name: create_milestone
tools.description: Makes a milestone (a group of issues) in this project, at once, when the owner asks in this chat; put issues in it with edit_issue.

tools.name: update_milestone
tools.description: Changes one of this project's milestones, by its id (the milestones tool lists them), at once: send only what changes. Removing one is the owner's, on its page.

tools.name: image
tools.description: An image the owner pasted in the chat, by the id its message names, to look at.

tools.name: request
tools.description: Asks the owner for an action request_fields describes: change an App setting; make or change a schedule, release or doc; offer an issue. Read its fields first.

tools.name: request_fields
tools.description: What a request action does and takes.
